collection.description: After a long day of work, two villagers sit beside the shore watching the fireflies.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: After a long day of work, two villagers sit beside the shore watching the fireflies. One asks what makes people human: their ability to reason, their love for one another, their mistakes, or something else entirely.

choices.label: Speak About the Lives They Share

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: They recall discoveries made because someone dared to ask an ordinary question.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: They admit that learning often reveals how much remains unknown.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: One remembers a small act of care that changed a difficult day.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: They discuss how kindness can require courage, boundaries, and difficult choices.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: One remembers a regret that still hurts; the other listens without insisting it be resolved.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: They disagree about what matters most and decide that the question deserves more than one answer.

c1__fx.name: Outcome C1
c1__fx.text: They laugh at their own mistakes and agree that learning matters more than never failing.

d1__fx.name: Outcome D1
